Agent Name: Orchestrator  
Step Number: 9  
Reason for Mistake: The Orchestrator prematurely concluded that the search process was yielding progress, despite partially incomplete data. A complete list of Ted Danson's series was never gathered and verified. WebSurfer provided only partial lists from fragmented sources (IMDb, TV Guide), along with superficial attempts to glean ratings and series information. The Orchestrator failed to validate the completeness of the data and did not ensure that all shows with more than one season had been identified. Additionally, there was no systematic collection of Rotten Tomatoes scores and Amazon Prime Video availability, which resulted in erroneous prioritization of "CSI: Cyber" as the answer without fully meeting the original user request criteria.
